# Door window regulator replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove the door panel, disconnect controls, and swap the old regulator with a new one. [t2252]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the three screws marked in red on the door panel.
2. Pop out the cushion near the far left screw to expose its fastener.
3. [Partial] Unscrew the handle or change holder located next to that exposed screw.
4. [Partial] Lift and pop off the piece covering the second screw, then remove it.
5. [Partial] Remove the third screw on the far right of the panel without removing anything else first.
6. Start popping out clips beginning from the bottom left corner of the door.
7. Run your hand underneath the panel to locate and release subsequent clips as you move up.
8. [Partial] Release the clip holding the top right triangle piece, then find and store it safely.
9. Disconnect the wire connector for the window or lock controls held by a bolt.
10. Pull the door panel upward and toward yourself until all clips are free.
11. Remove the two bolts securing the metal 'door handle' assembly.
12. [Partial] Take off the plastic trim to expose the inner workings of the door.
13. Remove the black metal piece covering the large hole in the center of the door.
14. Temporarily plug in the window motor connector just enough to establish contact.
15. Roll down the glass until the bottom edge is accessible for work.
16. Mark all bolts and connectors that need removal with red and blue markers respectively.
17. Unbolt and remove the regulator assembly while holding the window steady.
18. Wiggle the entire unit out of its hole in the door frame carefully.
19. [Partial] Let the glass drop down completely to clear space for reinstallation.
20. Undo the three screws connecting the motor to the old regulator body.
21. Align the new regulator with the mounted motor and secure it with those same screws.
22. Have an assistant lift the window as high up into the door frame as possible.
23. Slide the new regulator assembly through the hole while aligning its mounting points.
24. [Partial] Thread the wire connector for the motor through a small access hole in the door.
25. [Partial] Tighten all seven bolts securing the new regulator to the door frame.
26. [Partial] Lower the window until the holes on the glass line up with the remaining two bolt positions.
27. Reinstall those final two bolts connecting the glass to the regulator.

_Procedure reported by [t2252]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-window-regulator-motor-install.5617/>_

## Tools

- [Partial] Flathead screwdriver [t2252]
- [Partial] Two regular-sized screwdrivers (one normal, one large) [t2252]
- Ratchet with 10mm socket [t2252]
- Extension bar [t2252]

## Tips & gotchas

- Keep track of which screws and bolts go where during disassembly. [t2252]
- Store the small triangle clip from the top right corner in a safe place immediately after removal to avoid losing it. [t2252]
- [Partial] Temporarily plug in the window motor connector before removing other parts so you can test or position the glass easily. [t2252]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Losing the tiny triangular plastic clip at the top of the door panel while searching for it on the ground. [t2252]
- [Partial] Scratching the window glass during removal by not holding it steady enough when wiggling out the regulator assembly. [t2252]
